ITEMS  South Gate resident,  concerned  about plans to build  fifty-four  (54)
  condominiums  with  the lack of visitor  parking.  The South  Gate streets
  were not design  for the volume  of vehicles  this will  create. The residents
  are not anti-development  but do believe  strongly  in responsible
  development.

  Jose Morales,  5343 Almira  Rd., opposes  the proposed  development  at
  10130  Adella  Avenue  and is asking  Council  to support  the residents'
  requests.

ITEMS  CONT'D  Rob Houston,  City  Manager,  stated being  present  at the Plaru'iing
  Cornrnission  meeting  and there was discussion  regarding  traffic  impacts,
  the cunent  k-rail  that is in place to stop traffic  from  legacy  Lane into this
  neighborhood  could  be replaced  with  a gate in case of an emergency.  The

  gate would not be open all the time. The apartment would  have access
  throughAtlantic Avenue and not through the neighborhood.  Mr. Houston
  also stated that testing  of the soil has occurred,  and studies  can be
  provided.

  Leticia  Morales,  5359 Almira  Rd., thanked  the City  Manager  for his
  comments.  Ms. Morales  mentioned  that since the traffic  lights  were put in
  place, there have been sever traffic jams during  school  hours.  If a building
  with so many units is built then that means more people,  more traffic.

  Rosana  Larosa,  5205 Almira  Rd., opposes  the development  of 10130
  Adella  and appreciates  the City  Manager's  additional  information.

  Arturo  Alvarez,  5305 Aldrich  Rd., is concerned  about the development
  behind  their homes.  Mr. Alvarez  stated the traffic  is horrible.

  Susan Janer, 5314 Batavia  Rd., asked Council  to listen  to her neighbors'
  objections.

  Lizeth  Batres,  South  Gate resident,  opposes  the condominium  project  on

  Adella.

  Ricardo  Barba  Ochoa,  9719 HildrethAve.,  thanked  everyone  for their hard
  work,  he too, is a civil  servant  and it's a thankless  job.  Mr. Barba  Ochoa
  spoke about how fireworks  are an antiquated  means  of celebration  and
  traumatizing not only pets, but military  veterans.  He hopes there is another
  way to celebrate  without  fireworks.

  Daniela  Solorzano,  South Gate resident,  is concerned  about the proposed
  condos  at 10130  Adella  and the lack of transparency  around  the extent  of

  contamination  and cleaning  plans.  Ms. Solorzano  also opposes  the
  removal  of the k-rail.

  Lupe Perez,  area four, opposes  the Adella  project  atlOl30  and the
  removal  of the k-rail.

  Darla,  Aldrich  Rd., opposes  the Adella  project  at 10130  and the removal  of
  the k-rail.

ITEMS  CONT'D  Liz Ruiz,  South  Gate resident,  thanked  Chief  Arakawa  for responding  to
  the public  cornrnent  regarding  animal  abuse. Ms. Ruiz  is a South  Gate
  Plaru'iing Commissioner.  She is bringing  up a concern  regarding  residual
  contamination  at some sites.

  James Ganeo,  South  Gate resident  and Boy  Scout  of Troop  468. He is
  asking  for support  for his Eagle  Scout service  project  and helping  teens
  within  the foster  care system.

  Armando  Velasquez,  Independence  Ave.,  an exciting  report  from  the
  Kiwanis  Club  of South  Gate, Vice President  Ernma  is in the audience,  are
  launching  a new tradition  in the City  of South  Gate. It is the Golden  Apple
  and Heart  of the Hero Award  Ceremony  Program  for educators  and first
  responders.  The event is Friday  May  2nd at the Henry  C. Gonzalez
  Auditoriiun.  They  are selling  tickets,  selling  tables  and soliciting
  sponsorships.

F,MAILS  Claudia  Rivera,  South  Gate resident,  is frustrated  that her email  was
  misrepresented  at last week's  Planning  Commission  meeting  where  it was
  only  stated that she was against  the project  however  that wasn't  what  her
  email  was about.  It criticized  people  for going  to meetings  talking  about
  corniption.  She stated if the content  of our messages  is not going  to be
  conveyed  then people  should  not be allowed  to submit  emails  at all.

  Jennifer  Daily  commends  the South  Gate Planning  Commission  for
  rejecting  the appeal  and the zone change  for the Engle's  illegal  truckyard
  at 8530 Alameda  Street,  citing  health  and safety  concerns.  She asks the
  City  Council  to uphold  the commission's  decision  if the appeal is brought
  before  them and criticizes  the lack of enforcement.  She also questions  the
  termination  of the Community  Development  Director,  Ms. Meredith
  Elguira.

  Mario  Dominguez,  South  Gate resident,  expresses  his dissatisfaction  with
  Jennifer  Daily's  statements,  particularly  her accusations  that the City
  Council  members  are crooked  and corrupt.  He appreciates  Ms. Daily  who
  spoke against  the business.  He appreciates  Mr. Salinas  for clarifying  the
  governrnent  structure  and dismissing  the faulty  accusations.

  Mayor  Davila  commends  everyone  present  tonight  with  their  concerns  and
  stated their  questions  will  be addressed.

  Mr. Hurtado  thanked  Laura  Gonzalez  and the South  Gate Youth  Football
  for the jacket.

  Al Rios,  Council  Member,  thanked  the public  for attending  tonight's
  meeting  with  their  concerns.  He asked if the city participated  in the
  homeless  count  this year. He thanked  the Mayor  for inviting  the folks  from
  the college  to give a presentation  on the construction/time  frame.  He also
  appreciated  the Vice Mayor's  positive  cornrnents  on the college.

  Joshua Barron,  Vice Mayor,  had hoped the residents  were still  in the
  audience.  He lives on the westside  near the Calden  apartments  that have
  217 units.  The city is asking  developers  to bring  in projects  where  people
  can purchase/invest  in the community.  Mr. Barron  explained  about
  preferential  parking.

  Maria  Davila,  Mayor,  stated that anyone  is welcome  to email/call  the City
  Manager  and including  any of the Councilmembers  with  inquiries.  She
  attended  the Azalea  festival.  Ms. Azaelita  was canceled  due to lack of
  participation.  She reported  on the committees  she attended.

  Gil Hurtado,  Council  Member,  informed  the Mayor  that the Wi-Fi  went
  down  for fifteen  minutes.  Part of the meeting  was not seen.

RECESS  The City  Council  recessed  at 8:31 p.m.,  and reconvened  at 8:39 p.m., with
  four (4) Members  of Council  present.

CONSENTCALENDAR  Agenda  Items  3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 were approved  by motion  of Mayor
  Davila  and seconded  by Council  Member  Hiutado.
